ITEM 1 | Rectangular slice with a golden-brown, blistered crust edge, topped with glossy orange-red sauce and patches of melted white cheese, about 7 x 9 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting beside slice 2 on the upper left of the plate | 70
ITEM 2 | Rectangular slice matching item 1, golden-brown crust with orange-red sauce and melted white cheese, about 7 x 9 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting on the upper left of the plate | 70
ITEM 3 | Loose pile of crisp-looking green lettuce pieces, pale to dark green, coated in a creamy off-white dressing with some pale grated bits, about 14 x 14 cm and 3 cm high, lying across the center-left of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Irregular dark brown chunk with a rough, crumbly, seared surface and a few lighter flecks, about 4.5 x 8.5 cm and 3 cm high, sitting upper right next to the drumstick | 50
ITEM 5 | Drumstick-shaped piece with a glossy orange-red glaze, smooth juicy-looking skin, slightly charred edges, and a pale bone end, about 6 x 11 cm and 3.5 cm thick, on the upper right of the plate | 100
ITEM 6 | Separate pale yellow-green leaf piece with a crisp, firm edge, about 5.5 x 4.5 cm and thin, at the bottom left of the plate beside the lettuce pile | 15
ITEM 7 | Small pale off-white crumbly bit with a slightly moist look, about 1.5 x 2 cm, at the bottom center edge of the lettuce pile | 3
ITEM 8 | Creamy off-white dressing, thick and matte, coating the lettuce pile in patches and pooling lightly between leaves | 10
